note: Client withdrawal 2026-11-19: the three Arnold install photos are no longer used on either route; their history is under "withdrawn_client_photos" and "images" lists only what the routes render now. Round 3. Delivery policy: each image declares its largest CSS slot per viewport band (320-479, 480-639, 640-767, 768-1023, 1024+; max slot taken at the band's widest viewport with no scrollbar). Each band is a (the narrowest is the ) whose srcset lists only real files >= 2x that slot, so the file a DPR 1 browser picks (the smallest one) holds 2x; neighbouring bands with the same list merge. `sizes` states the true slot. "planned_*" and "delivery_r3" entries are calculations from the CSS model, not measurements; "controller_receipt_*" entries are the controller's native measurements. tests/franklinwh/imageDelivery.test.ts sweeps every viewport 320-1728 plus each band edge - 0.01px on both routes. Gate: max(cssW/fileW, cssH/fileH) x max(2, DPR) <= 1. Native proof of round 3 is DEFERRED to the controller.

superseded_known_gaps_r2.r3: Addressed by the 768-1023 band: hero, aPower 2 and both landscapes get 2000px files (>= 2x of 984 CSS px), racking is capped at 750 CSS px and gets the full 1500px original.

remaining_limits_r3: 2x is the guaranteed floor at DPR 1 and DPR 2. At DPR 3, Chromium may pick a candidate below 3x when DPR is under the geometric mean of the two neighbouring candidates' densities; the largest offered file also falls short of 3x in the 768-1023 band for all four single-column photos (max ratio 1.476), at 640-767 (1.092) and at 480-639 for the racking photo (1.2). aGate reaches 1.1 at 3x on its 440px slot. Those slots exceed what the 2000px customer originals can hold at 3x, or would need 2400-3000px manufacturer files.

Tablet bytes: at 768-1023 a DPR 1 visitor loads the 2000px hero (349 KB), aPower 2 (194 KB), equipment (158 KB), array (499 KB) and the 1500px racking original (407 KB). Phones 320-479 load 900px files (92/40/46/131/160 KB) instead of the r2 1300/900/600 mix.
No local browser in round 3: the band media, picture wrapper (display: contents) and selected bytes are source contracts until the controller's native capture.
